gloss: to receive (a favour); to be honoured with; to take part in

definitions.gloss: to receive (a favour or benefit); to be honoured with
definitions.explanation: To be given something good by someone of higher standing: praise, an invitation, a blessing. Used in humble, formal speech.

definitions.gloss: to take part in; to be involved in
definitions.explanation: To have a share in something, such as a decision or a plan. Most often negative: あずかり{知|し}らない (to have nothing to do with).

examples.japanese: お⟦{招|まね}き→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{与|あずか}る。
examples.english: To be honoured with an invitation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恩恵|おんけい}→恩恵：04115_onkei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{与|あずか}る。
{過分|かぶん}なお{褒|ほ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{与|あずか}り、⟦{光栄|こうえい}→光栄：19436_kouei⟧です。
examples.english: I am honoured to receive such generous words of praise.

examples.english: To take part in a plan.

notes:
A formal, humble verb. It sounds the same as ⟦{預|あず}かる→預かる：01817_azukaru⟧ (to look after, to keep something for someone), which is a different and far more common word.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お⟦{招|まね}き→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{与|あずか}る: to be honoured with an invitation
- ⟦{恩恵|おんけい}→恩恵：04115_onkei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{与|あずか}る: to benefit from
- ご⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{与|あずか}りました〇〇です: I am (name), whom you have kindly introduced (speech opening)
- あずかり{知|し}らない: to know nothing about, to have no part in

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{預|あず}かる→預かる：01817_azukaru⟧: to keep, to take charge of (⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}かる→預かる：01817_azukaru⟧) — same reading, different meaning
